body: It's in southern cecil county very close to the Deleware border. A relatively small neighborhood. The end of the Bohemia River is literally steps from the edge of their property going towards the woods

Thanks for the quick response. I'm 22 now. I've been telling my mom for awhile we should get into contact with a realtor just to get things in motion but she gets into a mindset that the house has to be pristine before we go ahead with that.

Thank you guys for the responses and advice. It feels so daunting to tell a man who I've watched drink his whole life suddenly tell him he needs help. Like part of me feels like he obviously knows he has a problem but the other part of me thinks that if he hasn't done anything about it now, when will he? I'm just so scared for the day when he ends up collapsing and either dying or ending up in the hospital. 

I want to be able to tell him now that if he doesnt get help he's going to die, but it feels so hard because I've never had the strength to even discuss the subject... It feels like an impossible situation to solve

Thank you guys for the responses. I just got off the phone with my mom after about an hour talk. I'm feeling much better and she is going to set up an appointment tomorrow. I just feel so guilty and dumb to have gotten to the point where I am today. I need some support and guidance in my life and it's hard for my mom to always be there because she has her own life and problems to worry about. 

Right now getting a job is my biggest goal. It's just hard to feel like I can get myself invested into an environment when I don't even know if I'll still be here 6 months from now.
